steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Concept: Technology has wide-ranging impacts beyond just technical considerations. As computing professionals and informed citizens, we need to understand the ethical, legal, environmental, and cultural effects of technology on individuals and society. | The Debate: Should governments and organisations be able to collect and monitor personal data to improve security? This creates a conflict between individual privacy and collective security. | The Issue: As technology advances, many jobs are being automated (performed by machines or software instead of people). This raises ethical questions about unemployment, retraining, and economic inequality. | The Issue: AI systems can reflect and amplify human biases.
